note: EXPLORER-2 11-12: which types / hard cores of the CURRENT plans of record execute each operator class of the token-path records (explorer/token/data/<design>.json, token_path_export 2026-10-20). The October records name October elements and instance globs that no current plan has, so the class -> hardware join is re-made here on the current module families. Each rule is a regex over node names (type name or core module) of the listed dies. confidence 'named': the module family is named for the function (e.g. ot_dsrom_su_* = SU, *_kp4_* = KP4 FEC hop); 'inferred': read from plan notes / placement, to be confirmed by the die owner. A class with no rule says so on the page. Cycles stay those of the token record (not re-priced).

field.why: ROM field = the slice leaves (ot_s81sl_*: vq / vn / ve / vs / vsw vector elements), the ROM columns col_h9/h10 (ot_rom_4096x72 macros) and the q banks / field nodes

hbm.why: HBM service column = the svc partitions (dsdv_svc_rs providers, svc band) beside phy__t1 (hard IP, not counted), plus the index / sequencer hosts

su.why: SU / softmax / HC cores: ot_dsrom_su_* and dsfd_su_t_*

select.why: selector / collector band: bk_sel and its dsdv_bksel_* cores

coll.why: TP4 collective: dsfd_coll_lane_* + collective FIFOs; the c1x/c3x slices carry the collective lanes

hop.why: stage hop = SerDes partitions with the full-KP4 FEC (ot_s81_kp4_dchn)

head.why: head die: hd_* partitions, LM-head elements ot_s81hd_elemA/B and lep pair

embed.why: Embed / Engram tables: the eng unit partition (dsdv_eng_rr)

me.why: ROM tiles (matrix engine): qfd_tile_* cores in the cb* compute blocks and the slice fe/fw/sc/stm/st parts

su.why: spine SU / SFU: sle/slw_su_* partitions and qfd_qc_su_lane_* cores

kv.why: HBM KV: the KV/system die (kv3_* partitions, qkd_* cores) and the compute die's UCIe KV PHY

link.why: TP4 collective: coll_* partitions, SerDes PHY partitions, ot_coll_fold_slice

head.why: LM head + argmax: no partition of the current Qwen plans is named for it (the October record ran it on the ROM tiles + spine SU)

embed.why: embedding ROM: no current partition named for it

SM.why: SM.MATVEC: the q_sm* partitions, ot_hbm_sm_* and accel_smh cores

ATT.why: attention tiles inside the SMs: ot_hbm_sm_attn_*, pv_merge, kv_line

SU.why: SU.VOP: q_su* partitions and ot_hbm_su_* cores

COLL.why: collective engine + SerDes: the NE/NW io partitions and hubs

DMA.why: record mover / VM: memory-controller partitions and vm cores

CTL.why: command processor / host endpoints: root partition, host cp and ep cores
